provenanceNote: Starting hypotheses written from public provider documentation and community experience — not benchmarked claims. PromptLoop refines these through your feedback, in your browser.

fields.instruction_style: Clear headers and short paragraphs; avoid deeply nested instruction trees
fields.reasoning_trigger: Fast model — an explicit reasoning request improves accuracy on logic-heavy tasks
fields.format_adherence: Good on simple schemas; flatten complex nested JSON
fields.verbosity_bias: Terse by default; ask for depth explicitly when you want it
fields.role_sensitivity: Low to moderate; task clarity matters more than persona
fields.context_placement: Handles long context well; put reference material before the question

house_rules.text: Mark every required section explicitly as required
One question per prompt — split compound asks
Prefer flat bullet constraints over nested rules

failure_modes: Skips optional sections when the ask is broad
Answers around a poorly bounded question
